scenicChapters.title: Luxembourg Mullerthal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: 54 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Luxembourg Mullerthal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 38 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-cathedral-city-of-luxembourg-its-.story: A 261 km round trip from Trier - roughly 4 h 30 in the saddle. On the way it passes City of Luxembourg: its Old Quarters and F, La place forte de Longwy, back through La place forte de Longwy and back through City of Luxembourg: its Old Quarters and F. It crosses Germany, Luxembourg and France - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
